candidates.title: Moving a page preserves content at the target and optionally creates a redirect
candidates.preconditions: Existing source page with unique text; destination title unused; redirect option enabled.
candidates.fixture: Move page to a new title with reason and redirect; open old and new titles.

oracle.observable: New title contains prior content; old title resolves as redirect when selected; move history records the operation.

novelty.rationale: Baseline creates/edits/deletes/redirects pages but does not map to page move.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline creates/edits/deletes/redirects pages but does not map to page move.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Try an invalid occupied target and verify source page remains intact.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Move permissions, title normalization and redirect suppression rights affect outcome.
candidates.uncertainty: Source checks permission/source/target and supports redirect choice; UI route and subpage/talk-page behavior need validation.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Moving a page preserves content at the target and optionally creates a redirect.

candidates.title: Watch and unwatch state is scoped to the signed-in user
candidates.preconditions: Two registered users and one existing page; watchlist initially excludes the page for both.
candidates.fixture: Watch the page as user A, inspect watchlist, then unwatch and inspect again.

oracle.observable: User A's watchlist gains/removes the page; user B's watchlist remains unchanged.

novelty.rationale: Baseline page create/edit/search/revert cases do not cover user-specific watchlist state.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline page create/edit/search/revert cases do not cover user-specific watchlist state.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Repeat with user B to verify isolation.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Watchlist expiry settings and anonymous account behavior can vary.
candidates.uncertainty: Source includes a dedicated watch action and watchlist manager; UI labels require review.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Watch and unwatch state is scoped to the signed-in user.

candidates.title: Upload validation rejects a disallowed or oversized file without creating a file page
candidates.preconditions: Synthetic allowed text/image file and a disallowed or over-limit control file; upload enabled in local config.
candidates.fixture: Upload allowed file, then attempt the invalid control file.

oracle.observable: Allowed upload is stored and addressable; invalid upload has a validation error and creates no file page/blob.

novelty.rationale: T04-D baseline has no mapped upload case.

baselineOverlap.rationale: T04-D baseline has no mapped upload case.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Use a valid small file as positive control and verify only one file record exists.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Upload config, MIME detection and storage backend must be pinned.
candidates.uncertainty: Pinned UploadBase marks disallowed/missing extensions as a title error before performUpload; exact API/Special upload error presentation and no-file persistence must be confirmed through their frontend paths and runtime.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Upload validation rejects a disallowed or oversized file without creating a file page.

candidates.title: A new edit creates a retrievable revision distinct from the prior revision
candidates.preconditions: Existing page with stable baseline text and known revision ID.
candidates.fixture: Edit one sentence and open page history or revision API for both revisions.

oracle.observable: New revision has a later ID/timestamp and new content; old revision remains retrievable unchanged.

novelty.rationale: Baseline edit and revert cases overlap with revision behavior; this narrower persistence/history oracle may still be redundant.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline edit and revert cases overlap with revision behavior; this narrower persistence/history oracle may still be redundant.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Attempt a rejected edit and verify no new revision is added.
candidates.testabilityRisk: History display/API state and edit tokens need pinned config.
candidates.uncertainty: PageUpdater links a normal edit commit to RevisionStore insertion; RevisionStore exposes lookup by revision ID. The history UI and baseline overlap remain for further verification.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: A new edit creates a retrievable revision distinct from the prior revision.
